text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At long last, her Make Debut race is here. 
Though Mihono Bourbon seems completely 
immune to nerves, she deadpans, "If it is 
deemed necessary, I will experience 
nervousness."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To the girl who executes everything like 
precision machinery, the instruction given 
was simply: "Run with everything you've 
got."
